name: Google Play Store app installation
description: Official Google Play Store route for finding and installing Android apps on supported, certified devices. Availability depends on device certification, region, Android version and app requirements.
license_note: Apps distributed through Google Play have individual publisher licences, permissions and data practices. Shopnoltd does not mirror or re-sign Play Store APKs.
notes: Use Play Store on supported certified Android devices; do not sideload an APK just because an app is missing.
Check publisher, permissions, compatibility and regional availability.
Some Android devices do not include Google Play services.
